criterion_text: The production-equivalent single-Agent, multiple-Session tmux server retains independent configured widths through create/attach/authorized row-only resize. If a real product defect is found, #2487 SC-09 is reopened with a distinct live witness rather than accepting test-only isolation as proof.

verifiers.summary: Multi-Session sharing keeps independent configured widths; the shared-server create defect behind the original 80x24 failure is fixed at the create owner

evidence.value: exact SHA 5c5165ec013170884bd52480c0b74c3945c13193 on tmux 3.4: 2x one Agent on one tmux server created an 80-column and a 96-column Session, both attach replies stated their own width, an authorized resize on the 96-column Session applied rows only, and the 80-column Session was unchanged

the shared-server create defect is found and fixed at the create owner: on tmux 3.4 a client attached to another Session discarded a new Session's requested columns; the create path now applies them explicitly; the #2487 SC-09 invariant it violated cannot rest on an isolated path, so this production-equivalent witness is its live evidence
